name: WCT
recent: WCT Holdings 在2026年11月进行高层人事调整，Lai Cheng Yee 出任集团董事经理，Lee Tuck Fook 改任执行副主席，Chow Ying Choon 辞去执行副董事经理职务。公司截至2026年6月30日的季度营收为3.7032亿令吉，净利1627万令吉，同比和环比均有所下降。近期无重大合约或企业活动公告。
notable: Lai Cheng Yee 获委任为集团董事经理，自2026年11月13日起生效。
Lee Tuck Fook 由集团董事经理改任执行副主席，自2026年11月13日起生效。
Chow Ying Choon 辞去执行副董事经理职务。
risks: 执行主席 Tan Sri Lim Siew Choon 在闭锁期前通知有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为3.7032亿令吉，环比下降16.8%，同比下降33.0%；净利为1627万令吉，环比下降13.5%，同比下降3.7%；净利率为4.4%，高于上一季度的4.2%。

recent_en: WCT Holdings underwent senior management changes in November 2026, with Lai Cheng Yee appointed Group Managing Director, Lee Tuck Fook redesignated as Executive Vice Chairman, and Chow Ying Choon resigning as Executive Deputy Managing Director. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR370.32 million and net income MYR16.27 million, declining both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter. No major contract or corporate activity announcements recently.
notable_en: Lai Cheng Yee was appointed Group Managing Director effective 13 November 2026.
Lee Tuck Fook was redesignated from Group Managing Director to Executive Vice Chairman effective 13 November 2026.
Chow Ying Choon resigned as Executive Deputy Managing Director.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Tan Sri Lim Siew Choon notified intention to deal in the company's securities ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR370.32 million, down 16.8% QoQ and 33.0% YoY; net income was MYR16.27 million, down 13.5% QoQ and 3.7% YoY; net margin was 4.4%, up from 4.2% in the previous quarter.
